ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% low-intensity (black) to 60% high-intensity (white) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are concentrated along the trailing edge and surrounding the median notch. Fine-grained dark mottling is dispersed throughout the white areas, with a higher concentration observed on the medial half of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped median notch with a pixel angle of approximately 45-50 degrees and a depth of roughly 15% of the visible vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels relative to the lobe body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature transitioning to a general concave sweep along the trailing edge towards the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) are concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark, vertical linear disruptions (parallel rake marks) are present in the central high-intensity white region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters on both lobe tips. A distinct circular dark mark/lesion is visible on the upper white field of the right lobe near the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific jagged indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from the regular serration frequency.
